name: mod-pack
description: A pack of small Claude Code mods that share the band above the prompt without overwriting each other. Turn each one on or off with /mods.

tokenWeather.title: Token Weather
tokenWeather.description: Show the context-window forecast above the prompt.

blastRadius.title: Blast Radius
blastRadius.description: Ask Proceed or Cancel, with a preview of what would change, before Claude runs a risky shell command (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git push --force, ...). A non-interactive run denies those commands. Costs no model tokens.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Let features that can play a sound do so. Off by default. Claude Code plays plugin sound only where it has a player (macOS).
